any malformed cursor → from genesis\n200\t        tailer = SpineTailer(self.server.store(), since_seq=since)\n201\t        try:\n202\t            while True:\n203\t                sent = False\n204\t                for ev in tailer.poll():\n205\t                    self.wfile.write(f\"data: {json.dumps(ev, ensure_ascii=False)}\\n\\n\".encode(\"utf-8\"))\n206\t                    sent = True\n207\t                self.wfile.write(b\": hb\\n\\n\")                    # client closed — end the stream\n213\t\n214\t    # --- POST (action plane) ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n215\t    def do_POST(self):\n216\t        path = urlparse(self.path).path\n217\t        if path != \"/api/action\":\n218\t            return self._deny(404, \"not found\")\n219\t        if not self._action_ok():\n220\t            return self._deny(403, \"action denied (token / origin / host)\")\n221\t        try:\n222\t            length = int(self.headers.get(\"Content-Length\", \"0\"))\n223\t            if length > self._MAX_BODY:                         # The network TRANSPORT — an\n7\tHTTP server over WireGuard, reusing the WS-C two-plane server pattern bound to a `bind_ok` address —\n8\tis a documented NEXT slice, not shipped here. `bind_ok` is the bind predicate that transport MUST\n9\tuse: loopback or a PRIVATE (WireGuard) address only — NEVER 0.0.0.0 / a public address.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport ipaddress\n13\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n14\t\n15\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n16\t\n17\t\n18\tdef bind_ok(addr: str) -> bool:\n19\t    \"\"\"True iff `addr` is safe to bind: loopback or a PRIVATE (e.g. WireGuard) address — never\n20\t    0.0.0.0 / a public / an unspecified address.\"\"\"\n21\t    try:\n22\t        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(addr)\n23\t    except ValueError:\n24\t        return False\n25\t    if ip.is_unspecified:                          # 0.0.0.0 / :: → refuse\n26\t        return False\n27\t    return ip.is_loopback or ip.is_private\n28\t\n29\t\n30\tclass BridgeDaemon:\n31\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n32\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n33\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n34\t        # the owner trust anchor — the persisted identity by default (injectable for tests)\n35\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n36\t\n37\t    def _authorized(self):\n38\t        from ..mesh import authorized_devices\n39\t        return authorized_devices(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey)\n40\t\n41\t    def pending(self) -> List[dict]:\n42\t        \"\"\"The phone-facing queue — minimal fields only (no subject leaks over the tunnel).\"\"\"\n43\t        from ..agents.approvals import pending\n44\t        items = pending(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey, extra_pubkeys=self._authorized())\n45\t        return [{\"seq\": r.seq, \"tier\": r.payload.get(\"tier\"), \"kind\": r.kind} for r in items]\n46\t\n47\t    def recall(self, subject: str) -> Optional[dict]:\n48\t        \"\"\"Read-only remote RECALL — \"where did I last see X?\" — answered from the owner's own\n49\t        GROUNDED on-screen OCR history. Returns the perception-recall provenance dict VERBATIM\n50\t        (seq/entry_hash/when/frame_sha256/quote) or None: A0, read-only, no VLM and no paraphrase —\n51\t        the served `quote` is the owner's verbatim captured OCR line, never an advisory VLM lead.\n52\t\n53\t        This surfaces the owner's own on-screen text over the tunnel, so it leaks MORE than\n54\t        `pending()`'s minimal {seq,tier,kind} fields. The network SERVER (a later slice) MUST\n55\t        therefore gate this behind an authorized-device (device-signed) read request; this daemon\n56\t        method is only the read-only core.\"\"\"\n57\t        from ..perception.recall import recall\n58\t        return recall(self.store, subject)\n59\t\n60\t    def submit_device_approval(self, payload: dict) -> int:\n61\t        \"\"\"Append a DEVICE-signed approval the phone produced — ONLY if the signing device is\n62\t        currently authorized AND the signature verifies (fail-closed). A rogue/revoked device or a\n63\t        forged signature is refused; the signed target_seq binds (no replay).\"\"\"\n64\t        from ..agents.approvals import SIGNAL as APPROVAL_SIGNAL\n65\t        from ..agents.approvals import verify_approval\n66\t\n67\t        class _Rec:\n68\t            def __init__(self, p): self.payload = p\n69\t        authorized = self._authorized()\n70\t        if payload.get(\"signal\") != APPROVAL_SIGNAL:\n71\t            raise ValueError(\"not an approval record\")\n72\t        if payload.get(\"pubkey\") not in authorized:\n73\t            raise ValueError(\"signing device is not authorized\")\n74\t        if not verify_approval(_Rec(payload), self.trusted_pubkey, extra_pubkeys=authorized):\n75\t            raise ValueError(\"approval signature invalid\")\n76\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n77\t                                 payload={**payload, \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"},\n78\t                                 supersedes_id=payload.get(\"target_seq\"))\n79\t\n80\t    def panic_engage(self, *, by: str = \"phone\") -> int:\n81\t        \"\"\"Halt the mesh from the phone. ANY engage halts (fail-safe) — no signature needed for the\n82\t        SAFE direction. Release stays owner-only at the desktop (the dangerous direction is signed).\"\"\"\n83\t        from ..governor.killswitch import SIGNAL as KS_SIGNAL\n84\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n85\t                                 payload={\"signal\": KS_SIGNAL, \"state\": \"engaged\", \"by\": by,\n86\t                                          \"reason\": \"panic halt from phone\", \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"})\n87\t\n88\t    def relay(self, text: str) -> str:\n89\t        \"\"\"Relay a KERNEL command — the same T0-router + WARDEN gate + signed action log as voice/UI.\"\"\"\n90\t        from ..voice.dispatch import KernelDispatch\n91\t        return KernelDispatch().send(text)\n92\t"}]},"uuid":"6bb4ec0d-fd34-4267-9194-c8c3eb2a578f","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:04.097Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e080456f-4d62-4b9a-b4a0-3ba178d0e51e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"3a81fe9a-e9f2-4af7-856d-c4489047984c","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a0896591ebaba6b0d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BqzCj9RYqShB4gegTjEi1f","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Device-signed, replay-resistant request envelope (Phase 9 W1-A) — the bridge auth keystone.\n2\t\n3\tThe phone (a device the owner AUTHORIZED via `sigil.mesh.authorize_device`) signs EACH request to the\n4\tdesktop bridge with ITS OWN Ed25519 key over the canonical envelope core. There is NO wire bearer\n5\tsecret: authentication IS the signature, verified against the owner-minted authorized-device set. This\n6\tmirrors the approval-record pattern (`agents.approvals._approval_message` / `verify_approval`) — same\n7\tcanonical-JSON message, same fail-closed `verify_one`, same trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n8\t(a rogue/revoked device cannot self-authorize; a tampered field breaks the signature).\n9\t\n10\tReplay resistance is a deterministic, spine-anchored monotonic-nonce highwater PER DEVICE: an effectful\n11\trequest must carry a nonce strictly greater than the highest nonce that device has ever been receipted\n12\tfor. Reads still receipt (advancing the watermark) but skip the freshness gate (they have no side\n13\teffect). The receipt is an append-only spine event, so the watermark is tamper-evident memory.\n14\t\n15\tThis module is PURE by construction — NO wallclock, NO RNG. The caller supplies `nonce` and `ts` so the\n16\tJS phone client and Python reproduce the exact signed bytes (the parity contract) and so freshness is a\n17\tdeterministic function of the spine. A wallclock timestamp-WINDOW check (is `ts` recent?) belongs to\n18\tthe server transport layer, not here. Offense-free.\"\"\"\n19\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n20\t\n21\tfrom typing import Set, Tuple, Union\n22\t\n23\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sign, verify_one\n24\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n25\t\n26\t# The request vocabulary the bridge accepts — a fail-closed allow-list. `panic`/`relay` are effectful;\n27\t# the `read:*` family is side-effect-free. An action outside this set is refused even if validly signed.\n28\tACTIONS = frozenset({\"panic\", \"relay\", \"read:snapshot\", \"read:pending\", \"read:record\",\n29\t                     \"read:stream\", \"read:recall\"})\n30\t\n31\t# The spine signal marking a consumed request. Its records form the per-device nonce highwater.\n32\tRECEIPT_SIGNAL = \"mesh.request\"\n33\t\n34\t\n35\tdef envelope_message(core: dict) -> bytes:\n36\t    \"\"\"The exact bytes signed/verified — canonical JSON of the core. This is the JS<->Python parity\n37\t    contract: a future JS client MUST produce these identical bytes. Mirrors\n38\t    `agents.approvals._approval_message` (return bytes; encode only if `canonical_json` gave a str).\"\"\"\n39\t    m = canonical_json(core)\n40\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n41\t\n42\t\n43\tdef build_core(device_pubkey: str, action: str, args: dict, nonce, ts) -> dict:\n44\t    \"\"\"The signed core. `nonce`/`ts` are caller-supplied (this module never reads a clock or RNG).\"\"\"\n45\t    return {\"v\": 1, \"device\": device_pubkey, \"action\": action, \"args\": args, \"nonce\": nonce, \"ts\": ts}\n46\t\n47\t\n48\tdef sign_envelope(device_key, core: dict) -> dict:\n49\t    \"\"\"Phone/test side: attach a DEVICE signature over the canonical core, producing the wire payload.\"\"\"\n50\t    return {**core, \"sig\": sign(device_key.private_key_b64, envelope_message(core))}\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tdef verify_envelope(payload, authorized: Set[str]) -> Tuple[bool, Union[dict, str]]:\n54\t    \"\"\"Fail-closed authentication. Rebuild the core (payload minus `sig`); refuse if there is no sig /\n55\t    no device / the device is not in the owner-minted authorized set; then Ed25519-verify the signature\n56\t    over the canonical core; finally require the (now-authenticated) action to be in the `ACTIONS`\n57\t    allow-list. Mirrors `agents.approvals.verify_approval`. Returns (True, core) or (False, reason).\"\"\"\n58\t    p = payload.payload if hasattr(payload, \"payload\") else payload\n59\t    sig = p.get(\"sig\")\n60\t    device = p.get(\"device\")\n61\t    if not sig or not device:\n62\t        return False, \"missing signature or device\"\n63\t    if device not in authorized:                       # trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n64\t        return False, \"device is not authorized\"\n65\t    core = {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k != \"sig\"}\n66\t    if not verify_one(device, envelope_message(core), sig):\n67\t        return False, \"signature invalid\"\n68\t    if core.get(\"action\") not in ACTIONS:              # allow-list the authenticated action (fail-closed)\n69\t        return False, f\"unknown action: {core.get('action')!r}\"\n70\t    return True, core\n71\t\n72\t\n73\tdef record_receipt(store: SpineStore, core: dict) -> int:\n74\t    \"\"\"Append the append-only consumption receipt. Carries only the routing fields — never `args`\n75\t    (which may hold a subject) and never the signature; the record is auto-tier (an A0 event).\"\"\"\n76\t    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n77\t                        payload={\"signal\": RECEIPT_SIGNAL, \"device\": core[\"device\"],\n78\t                                 \"action\": core[\"action\"], \"nonce\": core[\"nonce\"],\n79\t                                 \"ts\": core[\"ts\"], \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"})\n80\t\n81\t\n82\tdef device_nonce_highwater(store: SpineStore, device_pubkey: str) -> int:\n83\t    \"\"\"The highest receipted nonce for this device (0 if none). Non-int nonces are tolerated (skipped).\"\"\"\n84\t    hi = 0\n85\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n86\t        p = r.payload\n87\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == RECEIPT_SIGNAL and p.get(\"device\") == device_pubkey:\n88\t            try:\n89\t                n = int(p.get(\"nonce\"))\n90\t            except (TypeError, ValueError):\n91\t                continue\n92\t            if n > hi:\n93\t                hi = n\n94\t    return hi\n95\t\n96\t\n97\tdef consume(store: SpineStore, payload, authorized: Set[str], *, effectful: bool) -> dict:\n98\t    \"\"\"Authenticate, gate replay for effectful requests, receipt, return the core. Raises `ValueError`\n99\t    with the refusal reason on any failure (fail-closed). An effectful request requires a nonce strictly\n100\t    fresher than this device's highwater; a read skips that gate but still receipts (advancing it).\"\"\"\n101\t    ok, core = verify_envelope(payload, authorized)\n102\t    if not ok:\n103\t        raise ValueError(core)\n104\t    if effectful and int(core[\"nonce\"]) <= device_nonce_highwater(store, core[\"device\"]):\n105\t        raise ValueError(\"replay: nonce not fresh\")\n106\t    record_receipt(store, core)\n107\t    return core\n108\t"}]},"uuid":"b97b8652-6cb2-4a09-8711-5122ae2fcbd2","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:04.645Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3a81fe9a-e9f2-4af7-856d-c4489047984c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"0fc5f373-37db-45d5-9b85-10368925b4c7","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a0896591ebaba6b0d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DLLhqgDUjio5wSFvsSAi7w","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"PushNotifier (Phase 7, WS-D D-vi) — pushes to the phone when an A2/A3 item QUEUES, fed by the\n2\tSHARED P0 `SpineTailer` (the same primitive the UI SSE feed uses). The push carries ONLY\n3\t`{seq, tier, kind}` — never the subject, never the payload, never a secret — so nothing sensitive\n4\tcrosses even the WireGuard tunnel; the phone fetches any detail on demand over the daemon API. No\n5\tcloud push (that would egress the private subject off owned hardware).\"\"\"\n6\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n7\t\n8\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n9\t\n10\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n11\tfrom ..spine.tail import SpineTailer\n12\t\n13\t\n14\tclass PushNotifier:\n15\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, since_seq: Optional[int] = None):\n16\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n17\t        start = since_seq if since_seq is not None else self.store.next_seq - 1\n18\t        self.tailer = SpineTailer(self.store, since_seq=start)\n19\t\n20\t    def poll(self) -> List[dict]:\n21\t        \"\"\"New pushes since the last poll: one per newly-QUEUED A2/A3 item, minimal fields only.\"\"\"\n22\t        out: List[dict] = []\n23\t        for ev in self.tailer.poll():\n24\t            rec = self.store.get(ev[\"seq\"])\n25\t            p = rec.payload if rec else {}\n26\t            if (p.get(\"decision\") == \"queued\" and p.get(\"status\") == \"awaiting-approval\"\n27\t                    and p.get(\"tier\") in (\"A2\", \"A3\")):\n28\t                out.append({\"seq\": ev[\"seq\"], \"tier\": p.get(\"tier\"), \"kind\": ev[\"kind\"]})   # no subject/secret\n29\t        return out\n30\t"}]},"uuid":"2b785c25-c538-40a0-a139-807163e62b8a","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:10.935Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0fc5f373-37db-45d5-9b85-10368925b4c7","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"68919e2b-bf7d-4d57-bd28-ac179c194995","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a0896591ebaba6b0d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019L9nsEzeaBbk9KSKWbTLzq","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"SpineTailer (Phase 7, P0.2) — a live tail over the append-only, poll-only spine with an HONEST,\n2\ttwo-layer integrity model (red-pen-hardened: unkeyed hashes alone cannot resist a writer who can\n3\trecompute them):\n4\t\n5\t  • `integrity_ok` (CHEAP, per-poll, unkeyed) — per-record binding+derivation (`verify_record`) plus\n6\t    cross-record LINKAGE (this record's `prev_hash` == the last emitted `entry_hash`). This catches\n7\t    ACCIDENTAL corruption, a naive stale-field tamper, a deletion/reorder/gap. It does NOT resist a\n8\t    file-writer who recomputes cert_digest+entry_hash (a tip tamper or a forward-cascaded fork stays\n9\t    internally consistent) — so it is necessary but not sufficient, and is never presented as proof\n10\t    of authenticity on its own.\n11\t\n12\t  • `anchored` (KEYED, via `check_anchor`) — the owner-SIGNED head (`checkpoint.classify_head` /\n13\t    `verify_head`, Ed25519 1-of-1 trust root, monotonic `last_seq`) notarizes the prefix\n14\t    [0 .. signed_last_seq]. A recompute-fork or truncation AT OR BELOW the signed head is\n15\t    unforgeable without the owner key and is caught here; a monotonic high-water catches a rollback\n16\t    of even the un-notarized tail. Records with seq > signed_last_seq are the FRESH, not-yet-keyed\n17\t    tail — emitted `anchored=False` (well-formed but not tamper-proof), keyed at the next `sigil sign`.\n18\t\n19\tA consumer (UI/mobile) shows `integrity_ok=False` as \"integrity broken\", and treats only\n20\t`anchored=True` records as owner-notarized truth; the un-notarized tail is labelled as such, never\n21\tdressed up as proven. One primitive, two consumers — the UI SSE feed and the mobile push notifier —\n22\tboth drive `poll()` on a tick and fan events out via `Broadcaster`.\"\"\"\n23\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n24\t\n25\tfrom collections import deque\n26\tfrom typing import Optional\n27\t\n28\tfrom ..config import HEAD_PATH\n29\tfrom ..reuse import SignedChainHead\n30\tfrom ..reuse.chain import _GENESIS_PREV\n31\tfrom .checkpoint import classify_head, trust_root\n32\tfrom .store import SpineStore\n33\tfrom .verify import verify_record\n34\t\n35\t\n36\tdef _shape(record, *, integrity_ok: bool, integrity_reason: str, anchored: bool) -> dict:\n37\t    \"\"\"The cited atom shape emitted to consumers. `integrity_ok` = unkeyed well-formedness;\n38\t    `anchored` = covered by the owner-signed head (keyed). `text` is best-effort, never fabricated.\"\"\"\n39\t    return {\n40\t        \"seq\": record.seq, \"kind\": record.kind, \"source\": record.source, \"actor\": record.actor,\n41\t        \"ts\": record.ts, \"entry_hash\": record.entry_hash, \"text\": record.text(),\n42\t        \"integrity_ok\": integrity_ok, \"integrity_reason\": integrity_reason, \"anchored\": anchored,\n43\t    }\n44\t\n45\t\n46\tclass SpineTailer:\n47\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, since_seq: int = -1,\n48\t                 signed_head: Optional[SignedChainHead] = None, tr=None):\n49\t        \"\"\"Emit records with seq > `since_seq`. `signed_head`/`tr` may be injected (tests); otherwise\n50\t        the owner-signed head is loaded from `HEAD_PATH` + the persisted trust root.\"\"\"\n51\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n52\t        self.cursor = since_seq\n53\t        if since_seq < 0:\n54\t            self._last_hash = _GENESIS_PREV\n55\t        else:\n56\t            anchor = self.store.get(since_seq)\n57\t            self._last_hash = anchor.entry_hash if anchor else _GENESIS_PREV\n58\t        self._injected_head = signed_head\n59\t        self._injected_tr = tr\n60\t        self._high_water = -1                           # monotonic anti-rollback water mark\n61\t        self._signed_last_seq = -1\n62\t        self.check_anchor()                             # establish the initial keyed anchor (reads disk)\n63\t\n64\t    def poll(self) -> list[dict]:\n65\t        \"\"\"Newly-appended records (seq > cursor), each with the cheap `integrity_ok` verdict and the\n66\t        `anchored` (keyed) flag from the last `check_anchor`. On an integrity failure the event is\n67\t        emitted flagged (not dropped); the cursor still advances so the feed never re-emits or stalls.\"\"\"\n68\t        out: list[dict] = []\n69\t        for r in self.store.iter_records(since_seq=self.cursor):\n70\t            atom_ok, reason = verify_record(r)\n71\t            if r.prev_hash != self._last_hash:\n72\t                ok = False\n73\t                reason = f\"linkage break at seq {r.seq}: prev_hash != last emitted entry_hash (rewind/fork/gap)\"\n74\t            else:\n75\t                ok = atom_ok\n76\t            out.append(_shape(r, integrity_ok=ok, integrity_reason=reason,\n77\t                              anchored=(r.seq <= self._signed_last_seq)))\n78\t            self.cursor = r.seq\n79\t            self._last_hash = r.entry_hash\n80\t        return out\n81\t\n82\t    def check_anchor(self) -> dict:\n83\t        \"\"\"The KEYED verdict. Verify the owner-signed head over the current chain (unforgeable without\n84\t        the owner key): a recompute-fork or truncation at/below the signed head → `anchor_ok=False`;\n85\t        a monotonic high-water rollback of even the un-notarized tail → `rollback` set. Updates\n86\t        `signed_last_seq` so `poll()` can flag records beyond it as the un-notarized tail.\"\"\"\n87\t        entries = self.store.entries()                  # FRESH read from disk (not the cached head)\n88\t        head_seq = entries[-1].seq if entries else -1\n89\t        rollback = None\n90\t        if head_seq < self._high_water:\n91\t            rollback = f\"ROLLBACK: on-disk head seq {head_seq} < monotonic high-water {self._high_water}\"\n92\t        else:\n93\t            self._high_water = head_seq\n94\t        head, tr = self._resolve_head()\n95\t        if head is None:\n96\t            self._signed_last_seq = -1\n97\t            return {\"anchor_ok\": False, \"signed_last_seq\": -1, \"rollback\": rollback,\n98\t                    \"reason\": \"no signed checkpoint — the live tail is well-formed but UN-NOTARIZED \"\n99\t                              \"(run `sigil sign` to anchor)\"}\n100\t        try:\n101\t            ok, reason = classify_head(head, entries, tr)\n102\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — a malformed head must FAIL closed, never crash the feed\n103\t            self._signed_last_seq = -1\n104\t            return {\"anchor_ok\": False, \"signed_last_seq\": -1, \"rollback\": rollback,\n105\t                    \"reason\": f\"anchor unverifiable ({e})\"}\n106\t        self._signed_last_seq = head.last_seq if ok else -1\n107\t        return {\"anchor_ok\": ok and rollback is None, \"signed_last_seq\": self._signed_last_seq,\n108\t                \"rollback\": rollback, \"reason\": reason}\n109\t\n110\t    def _resolve_head(self):\n111\t        if self._injected_head is not None:\n112\t            return self._injected_head, self._injected_tr\n113\t        try:\n114\t            if not HEAD_PATH.exists():\n115\t                return None, None\n116\t            head = SignedChainHead.model_validate_json(HEAD_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n117\t            return head, trust_root()\n118\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — no/broken head → unkeyed live tail (honest, fail-closed)\n119\t            return None, None\n120\t\n121\t\n122\tclass Broadcaster:\n123\t    \"\"\"Fan-out of tail events to N subscribers with bounded per-subscriber queues. On overflow the\n124\t    oldest events are dropped and the subscriber is marked `lagged` so it resyncs from the cursor\n125\t    (never a fabricated 'you saw everything').\"\"\"\n126\t    def __init__(self, maxlen: int = 512):\n127\t        self.maxlen = maxlen\n128\t        self._subs: dict[int, deque] = {}\n129\t        self._lagged: dict[int, bool] = {}\n130\t        self._next_id = 0\n131\t\n132\t    def subscribe(self) -> int:\n133\t        sid = self._next_id\n134\t        self._next_id += 1\n135\t        self._subs[sid] = deque(maxlen=self.maxlen)\n136\t        self._lagged[sid] = False\n137\t        return sid\n138\t\n139\t    def unsubscribe(self, sid: int) -> None:\n140\t        self._subs.pop(sid, None)\n141\t        self._lagged.pop(sid, None)\n142\t\n143\t    def publish(self, events: list[dict]) -> None:\n144\t        for sid, q in self._subs.items():\n145\t            for ev in events:\n146\t                if len(q) == self.maxlen:        # would drop the oldest → the subscriber lagged\n147\t                    self._lagged[sid] = True\n148\t                q.append(ev)\n149\t\n150\t    def drain(self, sid: int) -> tuple[list[dict], bool]:\n151\t        \"\"\"Return (events, lagged) and clear both. `lagged=True` tells the consumer to resync.\"\"\"\n152\t        q = self._subs.get(sid)\n153\t        if q is None:\n154\t            return [], False\n155\t        events = list(q)\n156\t        q.clear()\n157\t        lagged = self._lagged.get(sid, False)\n158\t        self._lagged[sid] = False\n159\t        return events, lagged\n160\t"}]},"uuid":"de36d0f0-4ffa-4982-940a-f095938c7f85","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:11.789Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"68919e2b-bf7d-4d57-bd28-ac179c194995","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

-----------------------------------------------------------------\n32\tdef advertise_capability(store: SpineStore, descriptor: dict, owner_key) -> int:\n33\t    core = {\"signal\": CAP_SIGNAL, \"has_gpu_vlm\": bool(descriptor[\"has_gpu_vlm\"]), \"always_on\": bool(descriptor[\"always_on\"]),\n36\t            \"has_hid_inject\": bool(descriptor.get(\"has_hid_inject\", False)),\n37\t            \"has_camera_stream\": bool(descriptor.get(\"has_camera_stream\", False))}\n38\t    payload = {**signed_payload(core, owner_key), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n39\t    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"OWNER\", payload=payload)\n40\t\n41\t\n42\tdef capability_map(store: SpineStore, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None) -> dict:\n43\t    \"\"\"Latest VERIFIED capability per host_id (forged/unsigned advertisements ignored).\"\"\"\n44\t    tp = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n45\t    latest: dict = -------------------------------------------------------------------\n54\tdef authorize_device(store: SpineStore, device_id: str, device_pubkey: str, owner_key) -> int:\n55\t    core = {\"signal\": DEV_SIGNAL, \"state\": \"authorized\", \"device_id\": device_id, \"device_pubkey\": device_pubkey}\n56\t    payload = {**signed_payload(core, owner_key), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n57\t    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"OWNER\", payload=payload)\n58\t\n59\t\n60\tdef revoke_device(store: SpineStore, device_id: str, device_pubkey: str, _DEV_CORE, tp):\n75\t            state[p.get(\"device_pubkey\")] = p[\"state\"]      # latest verified state per device key\n76\t    return {pub for pub, st in state.items() if st == Reads are fail-closed: a missing key returns None, so nothing forged is ever trusted.\n5\t\n6\t`owner_pubkey()`/`owner_keypair()` READ the anchor (never generate — verification must not mint\n7\ttrust). `ensure_owner_keypair()` is for owner-initiated SIGNING actions (CLI engage/grant/approve):\n8\tit generates+persists the anchor once if absent, mirroring the checkpoint's `_owner_keys()`.\"\"\"\n9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n10\t\n11\timport os\n12\tfrom typing import Optional\n13\t\n14\tfrom ..config import KEYS_DIR\n15\tfrom ..reuse import KeyPair, generate_keypair\n16\t\n17\t_PRIV = KEYS_DIR / \"owner.priv\"\n18\t_PUB = KEYS_DIR / \"owner.pub\"\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tdef owner_pubkey() -> Optional[str]:\n22\t    try:\n23\t        return (_PUB.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip() or None)\n24\t    except OSError:\n25\t        return None\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tdef owner_keypair() -> Optional[KeyPair]:\n29\t    try:\n30\t        priv = _PRIV.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip()\n31\t        pub = _PUB.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip()\n32\t    except OSError:\n33\t        return None\n34\t    return KeyPair(public_key_b64=pub, private_key_b64=priv) if priv and pub else None\n35\t\n36\t\n37\tdef ensure_owner_keypair() -> KeyPair:\n38\t    \"\"\"Return the persisted owner keypair, generating+persisting it once if absent (owner signing\n39\t    path only). Same key material the checkpoint uses, so governance and the spine head share one\n40\t    owner identity.\"\"\"\n41\t    kp = owner_keypair()\n42\t    if kp is not None:\n43\t        return kp\n44\t    KEYS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n45\t    kp = generate_keypair()\n46\t    _PRIV.write_text(kp.private_key_b64, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n47\t    _PUB.write_text(kp.public_key_b64, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n48\t    for f in (_PRIV,):\n49\t        try:\n50\t            os.chmod(f, 0o600)\n51\t        except OSError:\n52\t            pass\n53\t    return kp\n54\t"}]},"uuid":"fff938e8-7bb5-44e6-ab0b-109eb31d224c","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:13.239Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3c6442c9-aa5d-4490-a4e7-03f2b8f3a5a3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

SIGIL\n4\timports NO `framework.*` module at all, which is the strongest form of the sovereignty\n5\tdoctrine (§1.3 / §12): the offensive engine cannot even be loaded into a SIGIL process.\n6\t`assert_no_offense()` proves it.\n7\t\"\"\"\n8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n9\t\n10\timport sys\n11\t\n12\tfrom .canonical import canonical_json, digest_payload, evidence_signing_bytes, sha256_hex\n13\tfrom .chain import append_entry, build_chain, sign_head, verify_chain, verify_head\n14\tfrom .crypto import generate_keypair, sign, verify_one, verify_threshold, KeyPair\n15\tfrom .models import AuthorizerKey, ChainEntry, Signature, SignedChainHead, TrustRoot\n16\t\n17\t__all__ = [\n18\t    \"canonical_json\", \"digest_payload\", \"evidence_signing_bytes\", \"sha256_hex\",\n19\t    \"append_entry\", \"build_chain\", \"sign_head\", \"verify_chain\", \"verify_head\",\n20\t    \"generate_keypair\", \"sign\", \"verify_one\", \"verify_threshold\", \"KeyPair\",\n21\t    \"AuthorizerKey\", \"ChainEntry\", \"Signature\", \"SignedChainHead\", \"TrustRoot\",\n22\t    \"assert_no_offense\",\n23\t]\n24\t\n25\t\n26\tdef assert_no_offense() -> None:\n27\t    \"\"\"Fail-closed: NO framework.* module may be loaded in a SIGIL process (doctrine §12).\"\"\"\n28\t    leaked = [m for m in sys.modules if m == \"framework\" or m.startswith(\"framework.\")]\n29\t    if leaked:\n30\t        raise RuntimeError(f\"SIGIL sovereignty violation: engine modules loaded: {leaked}\")\n31\t"}]},"uuid":"489cb255-e1cc-4f2c-b44f-2549587c2b1a","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:26.587Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6605687f-e71c-474f-bd01-81964b4f92ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"ec9463c5-ed60-4381-80aa-04a7f93ff06e","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a0896591ebaba6b0d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_011HYrtxYGYZ3QYuujfi3azh","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Append-only, hash-chained JSONL spine (SIGIL §6.1, D1).\n2\t\n3\tReuses CRUCIBLE's tamper-evident chain verbatim (`sigil.reuse`): each line carries\n4\t`{seq, prev_hash, entry_hash}` where `entry_hash` links prev+cert_digest+seq. The\n5\t`cert_digest` is over the record's CONTENT only (scope/kind/source/actor/payload/\n6\tparent/supersedes) — NOT the wallclock `ts` — so the chain is replay-stable. Appends\n7\tare O(1): read the last line's entry, `append_entry`, write.\n8\t\"\"\"\n9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n10\t\n11\timport json\n12\timport os\n13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n14\tfrom typing import Any, Iterator\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..config import SCOPE, SPINE_PATH\n17\tfrom ..reuse import ChainEntry, append_entry, build_chain, digest_payload, verify_chain\n18\tfrom .models import SpineRecord, now_iso\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tdef _last_nonempty_line(path: Path) -> str | None:\n22\t    \"\"\"Read the last non-empty line without loading the file (seek-from-end).\"\"\"\n23\t    with path.open(\"rb\") as f:\n24\t        f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)\n25\t        end = f.tell()\n26\t        if end == 0:\n27\t            return None\n28\t        buf = b\"\"\n29\t        pos = end\n30\t        while pos > 0:\n31\t            step = min(8192, pos)\n32\t            pos -= step\n33\t            f.seek(pos)\n34\t            buf = f.read(step) + buf\n35\t            lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n36\t            if lines and (pos == 0 or buf.count(b\"\\n\") >= 2):\n37\t                return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\")\n38\t        lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n39\t        return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\") if lines else None\n40\t\n41\t\n42\tclass SpineStore:\n43\t    def __init__(self, path: Path | str = SPINE_PATH) -> None:\n44\t        self.path = Path(path)\n45\t        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n46\t        self._last: ChainEntry | None = self._read_last_entry()\n47\t\n48\t    # --- write --------------------------------------------------------------------\n49\t    def append(\n50\t        self, *, kind: str, source: str, actor: str, payload: dict[str, Any],\n51\t        parent_id: int | None = None, supersedes_id: int | None = None,\n52\t        ts: str | None = None,\n53\t    ) -> int:\n54\t        content = {\n55\t            \"scope\": SCOPE, \"kind\": kind, \"source\": source, \"actor\": actor,\n56\t            \"payload\": payload, \"parent_id\": parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": supersedes_id,\n57\t        }\n58\t        cert_digest = digest_payload(content)  # wallclock-free\n59\t        entry = append_entry([self._last], cert_digest) if self._last else build_chain([cert_digest])[0]\n60\t        record = {\n61\t            \"seq\": entry.seq, **content, \"ts\": ts or now_iso(),\n62\t            \"cert_digest\": cert_digest, \"prev_hash\": entry.prev_hash, \"entry_hash\": entry.entry_hash,\n63\t        }\n64\t        with self.path.open(\"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n65\t            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n66\t        self._last = entry\n67\t        return entry.seq\n68\t\n69\t    # --- read ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n70\t    def iter_records(self, *, since_seq: int = -1) -> Iterator[SpineRecord]:\n71\t        if not self.path.exists():\n72\t            return\n73\t        with self.path.open(encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n74\t            for line in f:\n75\t                line = line.strip()\n76\t                if not line:\n77\t                    continue\n78\t                d = json.loads(line)\n79\t                if d[\"seq\"] > since_seq:\n80\t                    yield SpineRecord.from_dict(d)\n81\t\n82\t    def get(self, seq: int) -> SpineRecord | None:\n83\t        for r in self.iter_records(since_seq=seq - 1):\n84\t            if r.seq == seq:\n85\t                return r\n86\t            if r.seq > seq:\n87\t                break\n88\t        return None\n89\t\n90\t    @property\n91\t    def next_seq(self) -> int:\n92\t        return (self._last.seq + 1) if self._last else 0\n93\t\n94\t    def count(self) -> int:\n95\t        return sum(1 for _ in self.iter_records())\n96\t\n97\t    # --- integrity ----------------------------------------------------------------\n98\t    def entries(self) -> list[ChainEntry]:\n99\t        return [\n100\t            ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash)\n101\t            for r in self.iter_records()\n102\t        ]\n103\t\n104\t    def verify(self) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n105\t        \"\"\"Two-layer UNKEYED integrity: (1) BINDING — each record's payload still hashes to its\n106\t        stored cert_digest (catches silent payload edits); (2) CHAIN — the entries link cleanly\n107\t        (catches delete/reorder/entry tamper). This proves internal CONSISTENCY, not authenticity:\n108\t        a naive payload edit fails (1), and a mid-chain digest edit cascades an entry_hash/prev_hash\n109\t        break caught by (2) — BUT a writer who recomputes cert_digest+entry_hash for the tip (no\n110\t        successor to cascade into) or forward-cascades a fork produces a self-consistent chain that\n111\t        passes here. Resistance to a recompute-capable writer is the owner-SIGNED head's job\n112\t        (`checkpoint.verify_checkpoint`, Ed25519 + monotonic last_seq). Use this for corruption/\n113\t        naive-tamper detection; use the signed head for tamper-EVIDENCE.\"\"\"\n114\t        entries: list[ChainEntry] = []\n115\t        for r in self.iter_records():\n116\t            content = {\n117\t                \"scope\": r.scope, \"kind\": r.kind, \"source\": r.source, \"actor\": r.actor,\n118\t                \"payload\": r.payload, \"parent_id\": r.parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": r.supersedes_id,\n119\t            }\n120\t            if digest_payload(content) != r.cert_digest:\n121\t                return False, f\"binding break at seq {r.seq}: payload does not match cert_digest (record tampered)\"\n122\t            entries.append(ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash))\n123\t        return verify_chain(entries)\n124\t\n125\t    def _read_last_entry(self) -> ChainEntry | None:\n126\t        line = _last_nonempty_line(self.path) if self.path.exists() else None\n127\t        if not line:\n128\t            return None\n129\t        d = json.loads(line)\n130\t        return ChainEntry(seq=d[\"seq\"], prev_hash=d[\"prev_hash\"], cert_digest=d[\"cert_digest\"], entry_hash=d[\"entry_hash\"])\n131\t"}]},"uuid":"13211171-7f45-46d5-8db0-e0230937eae1","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:27.055Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ec9463c5-ed60-4381-80aa-04a7f93ff06e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"13211171-7f45-46d5-8db0-e0230937eae1","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"a0896591ebaba6b0d","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdAQbqbpcEsMojei5atzv","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BwinMRBMhPxDTuLU142uG2","name":"Read","input":{"file_path":"/home/kali/sigil/sigil/agents/approvals.py"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6770,"cache_read_input_tokens":57974,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":6770,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdAQbpCEmHEsjdNYdPCab","attributionAgent":"general-purpose","type":"assistant","uuid":"ad322982-561b-4fe9-8d93-238158fc6b7a","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:27.530Z","effort":"xhigh","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"ad322982-561b-4fe9-8d93-238158fc6b7a","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a0896591ebaba6b0d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BwinMRBMhPxDTuLU142uG2","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Approval queue (SIGIL §5, §9.3 mobile bridge) — the human gate for A2/A3 proposals. An agent\n2\tQUEUES a proposal (governor → QUEUE); the owner APPROVES or DENIES it here. Authentication is an\n3\tEd25519 signature over the canonical (target, decision, approver) by the OWNER key.\n4\t\n5\tRED-PEN HARDENING (Phase 6):\n6\t • The trusted pubkey is the PERSISTED owner identity — NOT the key supplied to the queue, so an\n7\t   attacker cannot self-certify by bringing their own key (RP-APPROVAL-2). approve/deny require the\n8\t   supplied signing key to BE the trusted owner key.\n9\t • `pending()` treats a queued item as resolved ONLY when a superseding approval VERIFIES against the\n10\t   trusted owner key, and keys resolution off the SIGNED target_seq (not the raw supersedes_id) — so\n11\t   an unsigned/forged approval can't silently drop an item (RP-1/RP-APPROVAL-1), and a genuine\n12\t   approval of one item can't be replayed onto another (RP-APPROVAL-4). `verify_approval` is thereby\n13\t   on the enforcement path (RP-APPROVAL-3).\n14\t\n15\tThis records the DECISION; it executes no external effect (SIGIL has no send/deploy path). The\n16\ttransport (Telegram/WhatsApp over WireGuard, §9.3) is a seam over this authenticated core.\"\"\"\n17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n18\t\n19\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n20\t\n21\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sha256_hex, sign, verify_one\n22\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n23\t\n24\tSIGNAL = \"governor.approval\"\n25\t_QUEUED_STATUS = \"awaiting-approval\"\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tdef _approval_message(target_seq, decision: str, approver: str) -> bytes:\n29\t    m = canonical_json({\"target\": target_seq, \"decision\": decision, \"approver\": approver})\n30\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n31\t\n32\t\n33\tdef verify_approval(record, trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str], *, extra_pubkeys=None) -> bool:\n34\t    \"\"\"True iff the approval carries a valid signature over its (target, decision, approver) by the\n35\t    OWNER key OR by a currently-authorized DEVICE key (`extra_pubkeys`). The claimed `pubkey` must be\n36\t    in the allowed set — which is composed ONLY of owner-minted keys (the owner identity + the\n37\t    owner-signed device-authorization ledger, see `sigil.mesh`) — so a key the requester merely\n38\t    presents is never trusted (RP-APPROVAL-2). The signed `target_seq` still binds (RP-APPROVAL-4).\n39\t    Unsigned / not-in-allowed-set / no-trusted-key → False (fail-closed).\"\"\"\n40\t    p = record.payload if hasattr(record, \"payload\") else record\n41\t    sig, pub = p.get(\"sig\"), p.get(\"pubkey\")\n42\t    allowed = set()\n43\t    if trusted_pubkey_b64:\n44\t        allowed.add(trusted_pubkey_b64)\n45\t    if extra_pubkeys:\n46\t        allowed.update(extra_pubkeys)\n47\t    if not sig or not pub or pub not in allowed:\n48\t        return False\n49\t    msg = _approval_message(p.get(\"target_seq\"), p.get(\"approval\"), p.get(\"approver\"))\n50\t    return verify_one(pub, msg, sig)                # verify against the (owner-minted) claimed key\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tdef pending(store: SpineStore, trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str] = None, *, extra_pubkeys=None) -> List:\n54\t    \"\"\"Queued proposals with NO valid approval yet, oldest first. Resolution requires a VERIFIED\n55\t    owner/authorized-device approval; an unsigned/forged/unauthorized approval leaves the item\n56\t    pending (fail-closed).\"\"\"\n57\t    if trusted_pubkey_b64 is None:\n58\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n59\t        trusted_pubkey_b64 = owner_pubkey()\n60\t    resolved = set()\n61\t    queued = {}\n62\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n63\t        p = r.payload\n64\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == SIGNAL and verify_approval(r, trusted_pubkey_b64, extra_pubkeys=extra_pubkeys):\n65\t            resolved.add(p.get(\"target_seq\"))       # honor the SIGNED target, not raw supersedes_id\n66\t        if p.get(\"decision\") == \"queued\" and p.get(\"status\") == _QUEUED_STATUS:\n67\t            queued[r.seq] = r\n68\t    return [r for seq, r in sorted(queued.items()) if seq not in resolved]\n69\t\n70\t\n71\tclass ApprovalError(Exception):\n72\t    pass\n73\t\n74\t\n75\tclass ApprovalQueue:\n76\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, owner_key=None,\n77\t                 trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str] = None):\n78\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n79\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n80\t        self.owner_key = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n81\t        # PINNED to the persisted owner identity — never defaulted to the supplied key (RP-APPROVAL-2)\n82\t        self.trusted_pubkey_b64 = trusted_pubkey_b64 if trusted_pubkey_b64 is not None else owner_pubkey()\n83\t\n84\t    def _target(self, seq: int):\n85\t        for r in pending(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey_b64):\n86\t            if r.seq == seq:\n87\t                return r\n88\t        raise ApprovalError(f\"seq {seq} is not a pending approval (already decided, or not queued)\")\n89\t\n90\t    def _decide(self, seq: int, decision: str, *, approver: str, reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n91\t        target = self._target(seq)\n92\t        # the signing key MUST be the trusted owner key — not merely \"some key present\" (RP-APPROVAL-2).\n93\t        if (self.owner_key is None or self.trusted_pubkey_b64 is None\n94\t                or self.owner_key.public_key_b64 != self.trusted_pubkey_b64):\n95\t            raise ApprovalError(\"approval requires the OWNER's signing key (missing or not the trusted key)\")\n96\t        msg = _approval_message(seq, decision, approver)\n97\t        sig = sign(self.owner_key.private_key_b64, msg)\n98\t        payload = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"approval\": decision, \"target_seq\": seq, \"target_kind\": target.kind,\n99\t                   \"target_tier\": target.payload.get(\"tier\"), \"approver\": approver, \"reason\": reason,\n100\t                   \"pubkey\": self.trusted_pubkey_b64, \"sig\": sig, \"msg_digest\": sha256_hex(msg),\n101\t                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n102\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n103\t                                 payload=payload, supersedes_id=seq)\n104\t\n105\t    def approve(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n106\t        return self._decide(seq, \"approved\", approver=approver, reason=reason)\n107\t\n108\t    def deny(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n109\t        return self._decide(seq, \"denied\", approver=approver, reason=reason)\n110\t"}]},"uuid":"673513c9-1fc3-4e6a-81eb-bb22632b95c4","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:27.549Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ad322982-561b-4fe9-8d93-238158fc6b7a","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Read fresh per decision\n8\tso a release (or engage) takes effect immediately.\"\"\"\n9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n10\t\n11\tfrom typing import Optional\n12\t\n13\tfrom .authn import signed_payload, verify_signed\n14\tfrom .identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n15\t\n16\tSIGNAL = \"governor.killswitch\"\n17\t_CORE = (\"signal\", \"state\")\n18\t\n19\t\n20\tclass KillSwitch:\n21\t    def __init__(self, store, *, owner_key=None, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n22\t        self.store = store\n23\t        self.owner_key = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n24\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n25\t\n26\t    def engage(self, *, by: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n27\t        core = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"state\": \"engaged\"}\n28\t        payload = {**signed_payload(core, self.owner_key), \"by\": by, \"reason\": reason,\n29\t                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n30\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"WARDEN\", payload=payload)\n31\t\n32\t    def release(self, *, by: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n33\t        core = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"state\": \"released\"}\n34\t        payload = {**signed_payload(core, self.owner_key), \"by\": by, \"reason\": reason,\n35\t                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n36\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"WARDEN\", payload=payload)\n37\t\n38\t    def is_engaged(self) -> bool:\n39\t        engaged = False\n40\t        for r in self.store.iter_records():\n41\t            p = r.payload\n42\t            if p.get(\"signal\") != SIGNAL:\n43\t                continue\n44\t            state = p.get(\"state\")\n45\t            if state == \"engaged\":\n46\t                engaged = True                      # honor ANY engage — halting is fail-safe\n47\t            elif state == \"released\" and verify_signed(p, _CORE, self.trusted_pubkey):\n48\t                engaged = False                     # only an OWNER-SIGNED release un-halts (fail-closed)\n49\t        return engaged\n50\t"}]},"uuid":"64b35416-7295-4291-8b5a-a8e2a5a7206f","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:27.943Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"80474c14-4b6a-46bb-8e0a-317ab588038c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

It forks the WS-C glass-cockpit server\n(`sigil.ui.server`) verbatim in shape (ThreadingHTTPServer + BaseHTTPRequestHandler, the strict\nCSP/nosniff/no-referrer header set, the body cap + 30s timeout, the never-log-auth `log_message`,\nthe SSE structure, the anti-DNS-rebinding Host/Origin/Referer gate) and changes ONLY three things:\n\n  • THE BIND. It binds a `bind_ok` address (loopback or a PRIVATE/WireGuard address) — NEVER\n    0.0.0.0 / a public address. The constructor asserts this; the CLI asserts it too. This is the\n    non-negotiable exposure guard: the tunnel, not the transport, is the network boundary.\n\n  • THE AUTH. There is NO wire bearer secret (the ui's printed token is gone). Authentication IS a\n    per-request Ed25519 signature the phone makes with ITS OWN owner-authorized device key — the\n    Wave-1 device envelope (`bridge.envelope`). The server verifies the signature against the\n    owner-minted authorized-device set (recomputed PER REQUEST so a revocation takes effect at once),\n    binds the authenticated envelope `action` to the endpoint it hit (a `read:pending` envelope can\n    never reach the more-sensitive `read:recall`), applies a wallclock timestamp-freshness window\n    (injectable clock), and for EFFECTFUL actions (panic/relay) additionally runs the envelope's\n    strict monotonic-nonce replay gate (`consume(effectful=True)`). The owner trust-root is NEVER used\n    to sign anything here — the phone signs, the server only verifies.\n\n  • THE ALLOWLIST. The anti-rebind Host/Origin allowlist is derived from the REAL bound address (plus\n    the loopback pair when bound to loopback, for dev), not a hardcoded 127.0.0.1.\n\nEverything sensitive stays off the minimal frames: `/api/pending` and the SSE stream carry only\n`{seq, tier, kind}` — never a subject, never a payload, never a secret. TLS wrapping is a LATER\nslice; this is plain HTTP inside the tunnel. Offense-free.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport base64\nimport ipaddress\nimport json\nimport time\nfrom http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse\n\nfrom ..config import SPINE_PATH\nfrom ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\nfrom ..mesh import authorized_devices\nfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\nfrom ..spine.verify import verify_record\nfrom .daemon import BridgeDaemon, bind_ok\nfrom .envelope import consume, verify_envelope\nfrom .notifier import PushNotifier\n\n_WEBAPP = Path(__file__).parent / \"webapp\"       # the PWA is a later slice — served if present, else 404\n_CSP = \"default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'\"\n_DEFAULT_PORT = 8722\n_TS_WINDOW = 120.0                               # ± seconds a request timestamp may differ from the server clock\n\n# Each network endpoint declares the ONE envelope action that authorizes it. Binding the\n# authenticated action to the endpoint stops a captured lesser-scoped envelope (e.g. `read:pending`,\n# which leaks only {seq,tier,kind}) from being replayed against a more-sensitive endpoint (e.g.\n# `read:recall`, which surfaces the owner's on-screen OCR history). `/api/graph` piggybacks on the\n# `read:snapshot` scope: graph returns only aggregate health, strictly LESS sensitive than the\n# snapshot, so a snapshot-scoped envelope reaching it is not an escalation (and a lesser envelope\n# still cannot reach it).\n_READ_ACTION = {\n    \"/api/pending\": \"read:pending\",\n    \"/api/snapshot\": \"read:snapshot\",\n    \"/api/graph\": \"read:snapshot\",\n    \"/api/stream\": \"read:stream\",\n    \"/api/recall\": \"read:recall\",\n}\n\n\nclass BridgeServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):\n    daemon_threads = True\n\n    def __init__(self, addr, handler, *, spine_path, trusted_pubkey=None, clock=None,\n                 ts_window: float = _TS_WINDOW):\n        host = addr[0]\n        if not bind_ok(host):\n            raise ValueError(\n                f\"refusing to bind {host!r}: the bridge binds loopback or a PRIVATE (WireGuard) \"\n                f\"address only — never 0.0.0.0 / an unspecified / a public address\")\n        super().__init__(addr, handler)\n        self.spine_path = Path(spine_path)\n        # the owner PUBLIC key is the trust anchor (injectable for tests); The\nphone path uses ONLY owner-authorized DEVICE keys — the owner trust-root is never needed to drive it.\nRun: ~/.sigil/venv/bin/python tests/test_bridge_server.py\"\"\"\nimport base64\nimport json\nimport tempfile\nimport threading\nimport time\nimport urllib.error\nimport urllib.request\n\nfrom sigil.agents.approvals import _approval_message\nfrom sigil.agents.base import Agent, Proposal, Tier\nfrom sigil.bridge import BridgeDaemon\nfrom sigil.bridge.envelope import build_core, sign_envelope\nfrom sigil.bridge.server import build_server\nfrom sigil.governor import Governor\nfrom sigil.governor.killswitch import KillSwitch\nfrom sigil.mesh import authorize_device\nfrom sigil.reuse import canonical_json, generate_keypair, sign\nfrom sigil.spine.store import SpineStore\n\nOWNER = generate_keypair()\nOP = OWNER.public_key_b64\nNOW = 1_000_000.0                                  # the fixed \"server clock\" every test shares\nCLOCK = lambda: NOW                                # noqa: E731 — injected so freshness is deterministic\n\n\n# ---- an agent that queues an A2/A3 with a SECRET subject (mirrors test_mobile._Emitter) -----------\nclass _Emitter(Agent):\n    name = \"TESTER\"\n    ceiling = Tier.A2\n\n    def __init__(self, store):\n        super().__init__(store, governor=Governor(store, owner_key=OWNER, trusted_pubkey=OP))\n\n    def run(self, tier, kind=\"draft\"):\n        return self._dispatch([Proposal(kind, {\"subject\": \"TOP SECRET wire $1M\"}, tier)])\n\n\n# ---- harness --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef _spine():\n    return tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".jsonl\")\n\n\ndef _serve(spine_path):\n    srv = build_server(addr=\"127.0.0.1\", port=0, spine_path=spine_path, trusted_pubkey=OP, clock=CLOCK)\n    port = srv.server_address[1]\n    threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()\n    time.sleep(0.05)\n    return srv, port\n\n\ndef _authorize(spine_path):\n    \"\"\"Owner-side (desktop) setup: mint an authorized device key. Uses the OWNER key ONCE, here —\n    never on the phone request path below.\"\"\"\n    dev = generate_keypair()\n    authorize_device(SpineStore(spine_path), \"phone-1\", dev.public_key_b64, OWNER)\n    return dev\n\n\ndef _env(device_key, action, args, nonce, ts=NOW):\n    \"\"\"The phone side: build + device-sign the envelope, encode it base64url-of-canonical-JSON for the\n    wire. Touches ONLY the device key — no owner key.\"\"\"\n    core = build_core(device_key.public_key_b64, action, args, nonce, ts)\n    payload = sign_envelope(device_key, core)\n    raw = canonical_json(payload)\n    raw = raw if isinstance(raw, bytes) else raw.encode()\n    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode().rstrip(\"=\")\n\n\ndef _approval_body(device_key, target_seq, decision=\"approved\", approver=\"phone\"):\n    \"\"\"The phone's OWN device-signed `governor.approval` payload (what it POSTs to /api/action). Built\n    with ONLY the device key — the server verifies, it does not sign.\"\"\"\n    msg = _approval_message(target_seq, decision, approver)\n    return {\"signal\": \"governor.approval\", \"approval\": decision, \"target_seq\": target_seq,\n            \"approver\": approver, \"pubkey\": device_key.public_key_b64,\n            \"sig\": sign(device_key.private_key_b64, msg)}\n\n\ndef _get(port, path, *, env=None, headers=None):\n    h = dict(headers or {})\n    if env is not None:\n        h[\"X-SIGIL-Envelope\"] = env\n    req = urllib.request.Request(f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}\", headers=h)\n    try:\n        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as r:\n            return r.status, r.read().decode()\n    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:\n        return e.code, e.read().decode()\n\n\ndef _post(port, path, body_obj, *, env=None, headers=None):\n    h = {\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\", **(headers or {})}\n    if env is not None:\n        h[\"X-SIGIL-Envelope\"] = env\n    data = json.dumps(body_obj).encode() if body_obj is not None else b\"\"\n    req = urllib.request.Request(f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}\", data=data, headers=h, method=\"POST\")\n    try:\n        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as r:\n            return r.status, r.read().decode()\n    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:\n        return e.code, e.read().decode()\n\n\n# ---- the bind guard (the exposure keystone) -------------------------------------------------------\ndef test_constructor_refuses_non_bind_ok_address():\n    for bad in (\"0.0.0.0\", \"::\", \"8.8.8.8\", \"1.2.3.4\"):\n        try:\n            build_server(addr=bad, port=0, spine_path=_spine(), trusted_pubkey=OP, clock=CLOCK)\n            assert False, f\"binding {bad} (public/unspecified) must be refused\"\n        except ValueError:\n            pass\n    # a loopback / private (WireGuard) address is accepted\n    srv = build_server(addr=\"127.0.0.1\", port=0, spine_path=_spine(), trusted_pubkey=OP, clock=CLOCK)\n    assert srv.server_address[0] == \"127.0.0.1\", \"loopback binds fine\"\n    srv.server_close()\n\n\n# ---- the device-approval phone path (/api/action) -------------------------------------------------\ndef try:\n        tgt = BridgeDaemon(SpineStore(p), trusted_pubkey=OP).pending()[0][\"seq\"]\n        dev = _authorize(p)                                  # owner authorizes the device (desktop)\n
